name: SCOPED_CARRIER_AUTHORITY
thesis: A carrier may be exact only relative to a declared source image, readout/query, continuation language and capability profile. Debt conservation is orthogonal: debt says what remains unresolved; authority scope says where a representation is licensed to support an accepted proof step.

fields.F0_id: Cryptographic identity of the frozen original source or exact source family member to which the authority claim is bound.

Reach.name: ReachContract
Reach.meaning: Defines the carrier states/transitions authorized as source-realizable, together with either replayable source-preimage receipts or a proved unreachable-state irrelevance contract.
forms: PREIMAGE_REQUIRED: every authority-bearing carrier state used by the trace has a replayable source/predecessor lineage.
UNREACHABLE_IRRELEVANT: an exact theorem proves that carrier states without source preimages cannot influence the declared readout under the declared continuation language.

fields.Readout: Exact observable/query preserved by the carrier, e.g. SAT existence, projected witness relation, model count, occupancy polynomial, certified conflict.

Continuation.name: ContinuationLanguage
Continuation.meaning: Frozen set/grammar of future contexts or exact operations under which the carrier adequacy theorem is quantified.
Continuation.requirement: Every authority-bearing operation applied while the token is active must be admitted by this continuation contract.

fields.Capability: Digest of the exact carrier/solver/verifier/policy/budget/protocol capability profile licensed to manipulate the carrier.
fields.Proof: Independent replayable adequacy certificate binding F0_id, Reach, Readout, Continuation, Capability and the carrier semantics.
fields.Expiry: Deterministic staleness rule. Any authority-defining field change invalidates reuse until a new token is independently validated.

formal_objects.source_states: Sigma_F: concrete/source semantic states admitted by the frozen source semantics.
formal_objects.carrier_states: C: formal states of the carrier representation.
formal_objects.realization_relation: rho subseteq Sigma_F x C. rho(s,c) means carrier state c is a valid exact image of source state s under the token's construction semantics.
formal_objects.reachable_carrier_image: Reach(A_scope)={c in C : exists s in Sigma_F with rho(s,c), unless a stronger replayable transition lineage definition is frozen}.
formal_objects.source_readout: R_F(s,k) for k in Continuation: exact result of applying allowed continuation k to source state s and evaluating Readout.
formal_objects.carrier_readout: R_C(c,k) for the corresponding carrier-side continuation semantics.
formal_objects.adequacy_condition: For every rho(s,c) and every k in Continuation, R_F(s,k)=R_C(c,k).
formal_objects.merge_condition: If a quotient merges c1,c2 into q, then for all source-realizable preimages s1,s2 of c1,c2 and all k in Continuation, R_F(s1,k)=R_F(s2,k); equivalently the quotient fiber is monochromatic under the declared source/readout/continuation contract.
formal_objects.unreachable_irrelevance_condition: If authority is allowed to quantify over formal c not in Reach(A_scope), Proof must establish that no accepted continuation/readout computation can depend on distinctions involving those states. Otherwise such states have no authority.

authority_rules.ACTIVE: All token digests/receipts replay, current source/readout/continuation/capability exactly match, and the current carrier trace remains inside the Reach contract.
authority_rules.STALE: The token was valid for a prior scope but at least one authority-defining scope field no longer matches the current requested use. Stale tokens may remain historical evidence but cannot authorize new semantic steps.
authority_rules.INVALID: Adequacy/preimage/proof replay fails or the token was forged/corrupted. Invalid tokens have no authority even for historical reuse.

SOURCE_REALIZABILITY_GATE.rule: Every authority-bearing carrier state or transition used by an accepted trace must either have replayable source/predecessor realization lineage under rho or be covered by an exact UNREACHABLE_IRRELEVANT theorem.
forbidden: Treating membership in the carrier grammar as evidence of source reachability.
Promoting a finite lack of source-preimage counterexample to a universal realizability theorem.
Using a normal-form/algebraic preimage as exact source identity unless the frozen contract explicitly proves that equivalence.

QUERY_CONTINUATION_GATE.rule: A carrier merge/quotient is authority-bearing only for its frozen Readout and ContinuationLanguage. Every later authority-bearing operation must remain in that language or trigger staleness/revalidation.
forbidden: Using a SAT-existence quotient as authority for model counting without a new proof.
Using a formula-specific future quotient for arbitrary future 3-CNF contexts.
Using an exact closed-component discharge theorem on an open component without a boundary-message contract.

CAPABILITY_GATE.rule: The token binds the exact capability digest. A different canonicalizer, carrier implementation, verifier, policy/budget/protocol profile, or proof-language authority requires a new/revalidated token if it can affect admissible operations or proof interpretation.
CAPABILITY_GATE.scheduler_exception: Changing only scheduler preference among already-authorized operations inside the exact same capability/scope does not invalidate semantic authority.

FIBER_GATE.rule: For every declared readout/continuation predicate family, quotient fibers used by the trace must be proved source-scope monochromatic. Polynomial representation size or finite collision absence is insufficient.

interaction_with_dual_debt.semantic_debt: A_scope does not discharge reconstruction debt. A projection still requires the existing proof-carrying witness discharge.
interaction_with_dual_debt.transformation_debt: A_scope does not execute deferred operations. A requested operation outside Continuation/Capability becomes ineligible under the old token and remains transformation debt until rerouted/revalidated/executed.
interaction_with_dual_debt.switching: A representation switch may install a new A_scope only after independent adequacy validation. The switch itself still has zero debt-discharge credit under DD3.
interaction_with_dual_debt.terminal: DD5 remains necessary. Scoped authority adds an admission premise: every carrier-derived semantic fact used in terminal construction must have been produced under an ACTIVE token whose source/readout/continuation/capability covers that use.

scope_digest.rule: The digest is authority identity, not semantic proof by itself. Every referenced payload must independently replay and bind to its digest.
scope_digest.historical_identity: Two tokens may describe extensionally equivalent authority scopes yet remain historically distinct if their proof/provenance differs. Reuse policy is exact-digest unless an explicit equivalence theorem is supplied.

open_vault_successor_contract.name: SCOPED_OPEN_VAULT_KEY_V2
open_vault_successor_contract.reuse: CACHED_OPEN_EXACT is reusable only when all three keys match and the refusal ledger independently replays.
open_vault_successor_contract.no_authority_upgrade: A scoped OPEN hit remains a capability/scope-specific refusal memory; it is not SAT/UNSAT/hardness authority and changes no debt ledger.

blind_discovery_wrapper.rule: Future discovery experiments that propose a carrier or scope must freeze source-bound candidate-visible bytes and current A_scope before target-aware labels/metadata are revealed. Observer paths must be noninterfering with candidate/checker bytes.
blind_discovery_wrapper.purpose: Protect generic discovery claims from label/provenance leakage.

factorized_computation_firewall.implication: A future representation-pressure hostile is scientifically admissible only if it rules out the frozen allowed factorized computation/DP routes under the declared A_scope, not merely if the semantic function space is exponentially large.
factorized_computation_firewall.novelty: Known dynamic-programming/knowledge-compilation principle; included as an anti-self-deception rule.

theorem_targets.SA1_SOURCE_REALIZABILITY_SOUNDNESS: An accepted authority-bearing carrier step cannot derive terminal authority from a source-unrealizable carrier state unless the active token's exact unreachable-state irrelevance theorem covers that use.
theorem_targets.SA2_QUERY_CONTINUATION_ADEQUACY: If an ACTIVE token satisfies the adequacy/merge conditions, replacing source-realizable states by their carrier/quotient representatives preserves the declared Readout for every continuation in ContinuationLanguage.
theorem_targets.SA3_SCOPE_STALENESS: Changing any authority-defining scope field invalidates old-token authorization for the changed use until revalidation; historical evidence remains immutable.
theorem_targets.SA4_SCOPED_OPEN_VAULT_SAFETY: Exact OPEN reuse under the triple key cannot alter semantic/transformation debt and cannot be interpreted as SAT/UNSAT authority; mismatched scope/capability is stale.
theorem_targets.SA5_SCOPED_TERMINAL_COMPOSITION: If DD5 terminal hypotheses hold and every authority-bearing carrier fact in the trace is covered by an ACTIVE source-realizable/continuation-adequate token, the terminal source-soundness theorem is preserved.

known_primitives: Contextual equivalence/congruence parameterized by allowed contexts.
Knowledge-compilation maps of supported queries and transformations.
Certified projected knowledge compilation with Skolem assignments.
prior_art_boundary.distinctive_composition_candidate: Dual-Debt lifecycle + explicit source-realizability authority + readout/continuation-scoped carrier validity + capability/scope staleness + proof-carrying exact OPEN memory + blind noninterfering discovery.

nonclaims: A useful scoped carrier always exists.
Reachability/source-preimage proofs can always be found cheaply.
A continuation language broad enough for arbitrary SAT can be compactly represented.
Scope tokens make an incomplete solver complete.
The combined architecture is historically unique or ahead of all systems.
